hook: Free medical care, every first Sunday
hookSay: On the first Sunday of every month, hundreds of families in Hyderabad get free medical care. You can help keep it going.

beats.label: Since the first camp
beats.say: Swecha's free multi-speciality camps have run {54|fifty-four} times, with more than {39,000|thirty-nine thousand} consultations.

beats.label: Who comes
beats.sub: from 183 areas in Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and beyond
beats.say: Over {11,000|eleven thousand} patients have come, from {183|one hundred and eighty-three} areas across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and beyond.

beats.label: Who gives care
beats.sub: up to 12 specialities · 200+ volunteers at every camp
beats.say: A network of over {60|sixty} doctors covers up to {12|twelve} specialities, and more than {200|two hundred} volunteers run each camp.

beats.label: Beyond the consultation
beats.sub: per camp · and up to a month of medicines from 141 types
beats.say: Patients get free blood tests, thyroid tests and E C Gs, and up to a month of prescribed medicines.

beats.label: Eye care so far
beats.say: So far, {2,700|two thousand seven hundred} eye check-ups, {810|eight hundred and ten} free spectacles, and {34|thirty-four} cataract surgeries.

outro: Your donation keeps these camps free. Donate at the link on screen.

end.title: Keep the camps free
end.small: Swecha Foundation · Figures from Swecha's 2026 programme proposal (through the 54th camp)
